youtube.title: Every Level of Reality (Most People Never Leave Level 1)
youtube.description:
There are 7 levels of reality — and almost everyone lives their whole life on level 1.

In this video, Stick discovers that color isn't on the world, that you always see the past, that your brain is guessing, that everyone lives in a different reality… and the one thing you can never doubt.

0:00 7 levels of reality
0:40 Level 1 — The obvious world
1:00 Level 2 — The paint isn't on the world
1:49 Level 3 — You live in the past
3:07 Level 4 — The controlled hallucination
4:12 Level 5 — Your reality is not my reality
5:23 Level 6 — The interface
6:34 Level 7 — What is actually real?
7:39 Not a ladder

Sources: Eagleman & Sejnowski (Science, 2000) · Lafer-Sousa, Hermann & Conway (Current Biology, 2015) · Gwynne & Rentz (1983) · Anil Seth, Being You (2021) · Donald Hoffman, The Case Against Reality (2019) · Nick Bostrom, Are You Living in a Computer Simulation? (2003) · Descartes, Meditations (1641) · Jakob von Uexküll (1909).

Which level broke your brain? Tell me in the comments.

#reality #perception #psychology #neuroscience #stickman
